scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Ah, I sense you have endured
a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
啊，我能感觉到，你经历过前世。
进入瓦尔哈拉之前，你一定学到了许多东西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Unfortunately, I don't think you're ready to become an Acolyte yet. Please finish learning all of the Basic Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很遗憾，我觉得你还没准备好成为服事。
请先学会所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
In the meantime,
I will wait until
you are ready.
May God be
with you.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
我会在这里等你准备好。
愿上帝与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I welcome you
back from Valhalla and
wish you luck on your
new life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
欢迎你从瓦尔哈拉归来。
愿你在新的人生旅途中一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth and seek those who need your help. May God light your path.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
现在，出发去寻找那些需要帮助的人吧。
愿上帝照亮你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth to seek people who need your help. May God enlighten your way.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
现在，出发去寻找那些需要帮助的人吧。
愿上帝指引你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I sense that you have endured a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
我能感觉到，你经历过前世。
进入瓦尔哈拉之前，你一定学到了许多东西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
However, I can tell that you are not suited to be an Acolyte. Please remember who you were in your past life and find your path.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
然而，我能看出你不适合成为服事。
请铭记你前世的身份，找到属于你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
What is it that you seek?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你所寻求的是什么？

scripts.text: Change your job to acolyte.
scripts.translation: 转职为服事

scripts.text: Ask the requirements to be an acolyte.
scripts.translation: 询问转职为服事的要求

scripts.text: Quit it.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Are you feeling okay today? I can tell by your attire that you are already an Acolyte. You're not joking around, are you?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你今天还好吗？
看你的装束，你已经是服事了。
你不是在开玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I'm sorry but it seems you already have your own job, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很抱歉，看来你已经有自己的职业了吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you truly wish to become a servant of God?
Let's see whether you are ready for it or not... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你真的愿意成为上帝的仆人吗？
让我看看你是否已经准备好了...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh my?! You haven't accomplished the basic practice yet?! You have a long way to go! Come again after increasing your job level!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
哎呀？！你还没有完成基础修行吗？！你还差得远呢！把职业等级练高了再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Hmm... your job level is enough...
Good. Now I will give you the qualification to become an Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
嗯...你的职业等级够了...
很好。现在我就授予你成为服事的资格。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always remember to be thankful to God, who takes care of us all the time. In chaos and times of difficulty, face your hardships with unwavering faith.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
要时刻心怀感恩，上帝始终照顾着我们。在混乱与困苦之时，要以坚定的信仰面对磨难。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Lastly, I want to sincerely congratulate you on persevering through your trial of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
最后，衷心祝贺你坚持完成了苦修的考验。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you wish to become an Acolyte?
Then, you must fulfill the following requirements thinking those are the practices given by God.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你想成为服事吗？
那么，你必须满足以下条件，并把它们当作上帝赐予的修行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
First, you have to reach at least Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills.
This is the most basic thing to do, so you need to regard it as the way of training yourself.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
首先，初心者的职业等级必须达到9级以上，并学会所有基本技能。
这是最基本的要求，要把它当作磨练自己的修行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
When you think you fulfilled this requirement, then come back to me again. Then you will have a holy job in which you can spread God's will.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
当你觉得已经满足了这个条件，就再来找我。到那时，你将获得一个能传播上帝旨意的神圣职业。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Please take care. They should know that you've met me by the time you arrive at the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
路上小心。
等你回到普隆德拉圣堂，他们应该就知道你已经见过我了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...? You must be the one who aspires to become an Acolyte. I've already received news from the Sanctuary that you might be coming.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦...？
你就是想成为服事的那个人吧。
圣堂已经来信，说你可能会来。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...
Are you one of the
Acolyte applicants...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦...
你是申请成为服事的人吗...？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Huh? What brings you here? This is a very dangerous place for a Novice like yourself!
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
咦？
你怎么来这里了？
对你这样的初心者来说，这里很危险！

scripts.text: [Father Rubalkabara]
scripts.translation: [鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Greetings.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh ho...
Have you come into the Deep here for training? Or are you just a Wanderer?
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦呵...
你深入这里是为了修行，还是只是四处游历？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I've sent a carrier pigeon with a message. I hope it will arrive there safely...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我已经用信鸽传了消息。
希望它能平安抵达...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Now, your name was {0}, right? Excellent, thank you for visiting me.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你叫{0}，对吧？
很好，谢谢你来看我。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I believe you've been told much about Acolytes from Friar Mareusis. Plus, there's plenty of helpful people in the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我想马鲁西斯神父已经向你介绍了不少关于服事的事情。
普隆德拉圣堂里也有许多乐于助人的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I guess there's really no need for me to teach you much. Besides, I'm sure your someone from your generation may have trouble listening to an old man like me. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我想，也没多少东西需要我来教你了。
况且，你们这代年轻人，恐怕不太听得进去我这个老头子的话吧。
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Still, lessons may come from the places you'd least expect. God loves to teach his children in strange ways. You'll see.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
不过，有时你会从最意想不到的地方学到东西。
上帝喜欢用奇妙的方式教导祂的孩子。
你会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Well, I'll send the message telling them that you've come to visit me. So, you may now return to the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
好了，我会传消息，告诉他们你来拜访过我。
现在可以回普隆德拉圣堂了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Your name is {0}?
I don't think your name
is on my list. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你叫{0}？
我的名单上好像没有你的名字。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Why don't you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary and check again?
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你不如回到普隆德拉圣堂再确认一下吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Welcome to the Deep. Feel free to sit and contemplate God's message with me. This place is beautiful, even if danger accompanies its sense of serenity...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
欢迎来到这片幽深之地。
不妨坐下来，和我一起思索上帝的教诲。
这里很美，虽然宁静之中也潜藏着危险...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Whoever you are, please take care of yourself. The monsters in here are shockingly strong, contrary to their cute appearance.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
无论你是谁，都请小心。
这里的魔物外表可爱，实力却强得惊人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a carrier pigeon to the Prontera Sanctuary. When you return, the Priest there should already have received my message.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会用信鸽给普隆德拉圣堂传消息。
等你回到那里，牧师应该已经收到消息了。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah, you must be one of the Acolyte applicants. I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
啊，你一定是申请成为服事的人吧。
诚挚地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah...!
You must be one
of the Acolyte applicants.
I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
啊...！
你一定是申请成为服事的人吧。
诚挚地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
...

scripts.text: [Mother Mathilda]
scripts.translation: [玛蒂尔达修女]

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hello there~
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
May God
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will pray to God, and hope that you become an Acolyte soon.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会向上帝祈祷，希望你能早日成为服事。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
What is your name? {0}? Let's see... Ah, you're on my list.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你叫什么名字？
{0}？
让我看看...
啊，你在我的名单上。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a message to the Sanctuary confirming that you, {0} visited me and completed your penance.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会通知圣堂，确认{0}已经拜访过我，完成了苦修。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Please return to the Prontera Sanctuary and speak to the Priest in charge.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
请回普隆德拉圣堂，找负责此事的牧师谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Now, what is your name?
{0}? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你叫什么名字？
{0}？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hmm...
It seems your name
is not on my list...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
嗯...
看来，你的名字不在我的名单上...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Perhaps you should return to the Prontera Sanctuary and check the destination for your penance trial once again.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
也许你该回普隆德拉圣堂，再确认一下苦修考验的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
How is your practice coming along? I certainly hope you're enjoying living in the grace of God.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你的修行进展如何？
愿你在上帝的恩典中生活得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
What?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
Whatever you are,
you look like an
Acolyte applicant.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿，不管你是谁，看起来倒像是来申请当服事的。
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
You look like an Acolyte Applicant. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿，你是来申请当服事的吧？
我说得对吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You...
Novice.
There something
you wanna tell me?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你...初心者。
有什么话想跟我说？

scripts.text: [Father Yosuke]
scripts.translation: [阳介神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey...
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿...

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Do you have anything to say? Because unfortunately for you,
I don't any replies.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你有什么话要说吗？
可惜，我没什么可回答你的。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Have you any more business with me?! You don't! Go back to the Sanctuary now!
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你还有事找我吗？！
没有了吧！
快回圣堂去！

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad, not bad. You withstood the penance trial pretty well.
So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
不错，不错，苦修的考验你完成得很好。
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
{0}，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Okay. I'll send a message to the Sanctuary that you, {0}, came to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
好，我会通知圣堂，说{0}已经来拜访过我了。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Now go back to the Santuary and finish becoming an Acolyte, kid.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
孩子，快回圣堂去，完成服事的转职吧。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad at all, you've made it all the way here from Prontera. So what's your name, kid?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
不错嘛，孩子，你从普隆德拉一路走到这里了。
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh? Why isn't your name on my list?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
{0}，是吧？
怎么名单上没有你的名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You probably made a mistake. Go back to the Santuary, and check with the Bishop.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你大概搞错了。
回圣堂找主教确认一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
If you like, come sit here with me and meditate the great truths. God's majesty is truly inspiring...
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
愿意的话，就坐下来，和我一起思索伟大的真理吧。
上帝的威严，实在令人心生敬畏...
